featured.title: SageMaker Image Classification MLOps
featured.description: Published by AWS under the aws-samples organization (MIT-0) - an end-to-end, production-shaped MLOps pipeline for image classification on Amazon SageMaker, declared entirely in Terraform across 86 files and 13 reusable modules. Event-driven ingestion, multi-architecture training behind hard clinical quality gates, human-approved governed deployment, and a closed drift-to-retrain loop. The worked example classifies medical images, but the architecture is domain-agnostic.

featured.title: AWS Organizations Governance on Control Tower
featured.description: Published by AWS under the aws-samples organization (MIT-0), the second after the SageMaker MLOps sample - a Terraform governance layer for AWS Organizations on top of an existing Control Tower landing zone. It declares the OU hierarchy, six Organizations policy types, Control Tower baselines and controls, and delegated administrators for 15 AWS services, all from the management account.

featured.title: AgentCore Harness Agent with Governed MCP Tools
featured.description: Published by AWS under the aws-samples organization (MIT-0), the third sample - a skills-based AI agent hosted on the Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness and deployed entirely with Terraform. Its tools run as an MCP server on AgentCore Runtime behind AgentCore Gateway, where a default-deny Cedar policy allows only the listed tools and callers, so Claude Code, Codex and Kiro can call them directly or hand a whole request to the hosted agent.

featured.title: Kalchar
featured.description: Production folk-art portfolio and commission site for a traditional artist - Madhubani, Pichwai, Lippan, and Gond artwork gallery with a buy filter, events, workshops, custom orders, and a server-rendered admin panel. Public pages are static, catalog lives in Neon Postgres behind a single data seam, and artwork images are served from Cloudflare R2.

featured.title: GitScope
featured.description: A Chrome extension plus web dashboard that adds deep GitHub profile insights - 9-stat grid, coding personality badges, language breakdown, activity heatmap, contribution donut, repo growth timeline, profile comparison, and a leaderboard across everyone you follow. Published on the Chrome Web Store with GitHub OAuth for traffic analytics.

featured.title: Ledger Sync
featured.description: A self-hosted personal finance dashboard with an AI chatbot that uses 15 read-only tool calls to answer questions about your spending, trends, tax, and goals. Upload Excel/CSV bank statements, get SHA-256 deduplication, 50/30/20 budgeting, bill calendar, GST analysis, subscription tracking, year-in-review, FIRE planning (Lean/Barista/Standard/Fat), India FY tax estimation, Sankey cash flow, and a Financial Health Score across 8 metrics.

featured.title: LeetCode Rating Predictor
featured.description: Full-stack LeetCode contest rating predictor using a Dense neural network trained on 121K+ contest records, featuring a FastAPI backend with LeetCode GraphQL integration and a React glassmorphism frontend.

featured.title: Blue Green AWS Terraform
featured.description: A comprehensive Infrastructure as Code solution for implementing Blue-Green deployment on AWS using Terraform, providing a complete CI/CD pipeline with zero-downtime deployments across ECS on EC2, ALB, CodePipeline, and KMS-encrypted artifacts.

featured.title: Instagram Likes Leaderboard
featured.description: A browser-based tool with three modes - Likes Leaderboard, Stats Dashboard, and Follower Analysis - that scans your Instagram posts and surfaces your biggest fans, ghost followers, non-mutuals, and engagement metrics. No downloads or sign-ups required.

featured.title: Personal Portfolio
featured.description: This site - a minimal dark developer portfolio with an ambient aurora background, project cards with an animated SVG cover scene for every project, and a fully data-driven JSON architecture. Built with React 19, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion, and Lenis smooth scroll.

featured.title: SelfHub
featured.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that acts as your personal digital memory hub - store notes, preferences, code snippets, tasks, and any info from any MCP-enabled AI assistant (Claude Desktop, VS Code Copilot). Your personal knowledge base travels with you across AI conversations.

community.title: orrery
community.description: Animated architecture and system design diagrams from one YAML spec, with 16,682 official icons from AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, GitHub and IBM. The Eclipse Layout Kernel places nested boundaries and routes edges, packets travel every edge and numbered steps play in order, and one spec renders to SVG, PNG, editable draw.io, a React component and an HTML viewer. Ships as an Agent Skill and Claude Code plugin.

community.title: svg-forge
community.description: A Claude Code plugin for designing animated SVGs that render everywhere they are shown: self-contained files for GitHub READMEs and img tags, and React plus Motion scenes for web apps. It packages the rules and gotchas from building animated README cards and project cover scenes into three skills, a designer agent, a generator, and a validator.

community.title: agent-brain
community.description: An agent harness plus a shared markdown brain that Claude Code, Codex and Kiro all read and write. Each fact is one markdown file with its source; facts get corrected or withdrawn with history, never silently overwritten, and recall runs over BM25 through a stdio MCP server. Ships with 15 skills, 7 subagents, safety hooks, always-on rules, and 27 public lessons from real failures.

community.title: Shared Workflows
community.description: Seven reusable GitHub Actions workflows that 11 of my repos call with a one-line uses: reference instead of copying CI. Node and Python CI, GitHub Pages deploys, Docker builds with a Trivy scan, dependency and filesystem security scans, Terraform checks with Checkov, and tag-triggered releases.

community.title: GitHub Stats Card Action
community.description: A GitHub Action that renders an animated GitHub stats card as an SVG in your own repo, so your profile README never depends on a hosted widget. Five stat tiles, a contribution calendar, current and longest streak, and top languages in one self-hosted card, published on the GitHub Marketplace.

community.title: LeetCode Card Action
community.description: A GitHub Action that renders an animated LeetCode card as an SVG in your own repo. Contest rating history is drawn as a line with the peak marked, next to the contest badge, current rating, top percentage, and problems solved by difficulty. Published on the GitHub Marketplace.

community.title: OSS Contributions Card Action
community.description: A GitHub Action that finds your merged and open pull requests to other people's repos through the GitHub GraphQL search, with no manual list to maintain, and renders them as animated SVG cards in your own repo: a summary card, a merged list, and an in-review list. Published on the GitHub Marketplace.

community.title: readme-kit
community.description: A GitHub Action that turns one profile.yml into a matching set of self-hosted animated SVG cards for your GitHub profile README: hero, terminal, section headers, divider, footer, timeline, tiles, panels, stats, buttons, and project cards. One theme.accent colors the whole set. Published on the GitHub Marketplace.

community.title: skillcheck
community.description: Conformance suite for Agent Skills (SKILL.md), published on npm. Linters check syntax; skillcheck checks reality: 36 rules with exact skills-ref parity, a 19-field client-extension registry across 3 runtimes (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor), structure and reference validation, SARIF output, and a drop-in GitHub Action listed on the GitHub Marketplace.

community.title: ITR Agent
community.description: Local-first MCP server that walks you through filing an Indian income tax return, published on npm. 12 tools spanning form selection, deterministic computation, old-vs-new regime comparison, advance tax planning, and document parsing - all on your machine. The LLM never does arithmetic; every number comes from a versioned, auditable rule pack. Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and any MCP client.

community.title: Claude Skills
community.description: Custom Claude Code plugin marketplace with 16 curated plugins covering dev workflow, Docker, dependency audits, refactoring, git workflows, open source contributions, Python clean code, animation, and more, plus svg-forge listed from its own repo. Installable via /plugin marketplace.

community.title: Claude Cost Optimizer
community.description: Installable Claude Code plugin with a cost-mode skill for concise responses, model routing, budget hooks, and efficient workflow patterns, plus claude-rate, a local CLI that grades a project, your ~/.claude setup, and 30 days of real usage. Includes web-based Repo Analyzer, Cost Calculator, and Badge Checker tools.

community.title: Bedrock Multi-Model MCP
community.description: MCP server for AWS Bedrock - text, image, video generation, and embeddings across Llama 4, Mistral, Nova, Cohere, DeepSeek, Qwen, GPT-OSS, Stability AI, Luma, and Claude. Use any Bedrock model from Claude Code or any MCP client. Supports bearer token auth and side-by-side model comparison.

community.title: MCP Toolkit
community.description: Reusable utilities and middleware for building MCP servers, in beta. Drop-in packages for the TypeScript SDK covering auth, caching, rate limiting, logging, and CORS - so you stop reimplementing the same plumbing for every MCP server. Not on npm yet, so it builds from source.

community.title: Claude Code Recipes
community.description: 47 copy-paste recipes for Claude Code covering 15 commands, 9 subagents, 5 hooks, skills, workflows, CLAUDE.md templates, and MCP configs. Every recipe works out of the box - just drop into your .claude/ folder and use immediately.

community.title: Awesome MCP Servers
community.description: A curated [awesome] list of Model Context Protocol servers, frameworks, clients, tutorials, and community resources - covering data, developer tools, cloud, productivity, search, AI/ML, finance, and observability.

community.title: Deploy Guide
community.description: Step-by-step deployment guides for every platform - 38 guides, 13 platforms, 14 frameworks, 6 databases. Covers GitHub Pages, Vercel, Render, Railway, Fly.io, Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, AWS ECS, DigitalOcean, and more.

community.title: Agent Recipes
community.description: Copy-paste AI agent workflows for real-world developer tasks - code review, testing, migrations, documentation, security scanning, and deployment automation. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Aider, or any AI coding assistant.

community.title: AI Git Hooks
community.description: AI-powered git hooks that review code, generate commit messages, catch bugs, and scan for security issues before you push. Drop-in hooks using Claude, OpenAI, or local Ollama for every stage of your git workflow.

community.title: Credly Badge README Action
community.description: A GitHub Action that auto-syncs your Credly certifications and badges to your GitHub profile README - no more manual updates when you earn a new cert. Categorizes badges into Industry Certifications, Professional/Partner, and Knowledge/Learning with non-destructive HTML-marker updates. Since v1.1.0 an SVG card mode (output readme, svg, or both) draws every badge into one animated SVG card in two or three groups, and since v1.2.0 the card inlines its badges as WebP at under a third of the old size.
